tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul log 'dren mthar byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ rgyal ba'i mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis/ /las nyon 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms zhing / /rnam mang 'gro la dgos 'dod kun stsol ba'i/ /bla ma phyag na rdo rjes dge legs stsol/ /'dir dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul nag 'gros ma ni/ gsang chen zab mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing 'di'i rjes gnang thob pa'i gang zag gis zla ba gang rung gi mar ngo'i gza' tshes shis par/ gnas yid du 'ong bar/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris sku yod na zhal shar ram lhor phyogs par dgram/ de'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs par ras la sogs pas bkab pa la 'bru sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i steng du phye gtsang chu chang bdud rtsi ril bu'i khu ba las sbrus pa'i zlum gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa mar rgyan ci mdzes dang / dmigs sha ma yin pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mdun du/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi khar rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas rnams bshams la/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug sgrub khang gi phyir mtshams tho dkar po btsugs la/ tshes de'i dgong thun nas bzung nyams len gyi rim pa ni/ mchod pa rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/

so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ mthar rol mo dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ṭa/ pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bhā wi na/ badz+ra dharmā hrīḥd ya ni/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa lan bdun nam/ nyer gcig tsam brjod pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi thugs khar zla ba la khams gsum ma lus pa gsal bar nus pa'i 'od zer yang dag par 'khrigs pa'i raṃ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shu n+yā tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i pho brang ches shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥyig las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du aṃ yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dwangs shing gsal ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag

zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje sngon po rwa gdengs 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa phyag gnyis thugs khar 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yog gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing / g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris shing / skra ser po thor tshugs can kha bub tu mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i dbang po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ ming med gnyis po bcings byas te/ /mdzub mo gnyis po bskum par bya/ /mthe'u chung gung mo de bzhin du/ /mtheb chen gyis ni mnan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar gyis rtsa ba'i phyag rgya snying kha/ mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ spyi bo bzhir reg cing / hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ ces brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad/ thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba las rab tu 'bar ba'i sngags kyi 'od zer mar me'i phreng ba lta bu dpag tu med pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab cing snang bar byas pas nad rims gdon bgegs byad kha rbod gtong mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas rang 'dra'i khro chung dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / khro bo'i sngags bzlas/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ ces dang / oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra/ bhū ta a dhi pa ti/ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥki ri ṭi na/ sarba bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsā na sā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ man ngag shes na rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci nus bya/ thun 'jog pa na/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swā bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shudho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas/

rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ sha lnga bdud brtsi lnga rnams bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kha nas/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya chen ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i pho brang ches shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥyig las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du aṃ yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dwangs shing gsal ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje sngon po rwa gdengs pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin zhing /

g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa phyag gnyis thugs khar 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris shing skra ser po'i thor tshugs can kha sbub tu mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i dbang po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wa ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wid+yṃ āḥhūm̐/ a ོཾbadz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dzaḥhū?m̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba tā tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra/ nas/ sā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+yanut+pan na tat+t+wa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes sbrel la lan gsum mam lnga'i bdun gyis phul/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ dpal chen nam mkha'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing / /dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong chems/ /'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa/ /mthu chen rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum mkha' dbyings dag pa'i thugs/ /char sprin sku lus dang 'grogs nas/ /hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug gi nga ro yis/ /log 'dren 'dul mdzad dbang por 'dud/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /dngos grub mtha' yas stsol ba dang / /nyid kyi go 'phang la gnas mdzod/ /bde kyai sogs yi dam gzhan dang chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na skabs 'dir bya dgos pas/ bsham gyi skabs su'ang so so'i gtor ma bshams pa'am yang na 'byung 'dul gyi gtor ma de thams cad la 'bul/ gang ltar rjes chog ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha drī ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/

sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa mā ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing / lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang mchod pa'i yul dam pa mdzad nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing nas la sogs pa rten rnams la gtor/ gtor mgron gyi rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang /

/slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rten med na gshegs gsol mi rung bas/ gsang rten byed kyi yod na de la dang / med na/ mdun gyi mgon po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ zhes brjod pa man ngag dam pa yin no/ /rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skye dang skye ba gnas bzang por/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin/ /rnam par dag pa'i rgyud gcig la/ /skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod paṇa bcings/ /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/

/mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /dpal chen nam mkha'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing / /dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong chems/ /'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa/ /mthu chen rdo rje rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam bha lha/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin du spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal dam pa thob pa gcig tu gyur cig rang nyid gnas skabs thams cad rdo rje'i pho brang yangs pa'i nang du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa byed na zla ba gcig du thun gsum gyi sbyor bas sngags thung 'bum phrag bcu dang / sngags ring khri phrag bcu bzla'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dam pa thams cad kyi 'dren pa 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung che chung gi snying po bsdus nas nyams su blangs bde bar ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad 'dug pa bzhin sngags ring khri phrag bcu bzla'o/

/zhes pa 'di ni dam pa thams cad kyi 'dren pa 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung che chung gi snying po bsdus nas nyams su blang bde bar ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad 'dug pa bzhin la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi chings dang sogs khongs nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis rigs kyi tsha mo 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma 'byung 'dul gyi bsnyen pa byed skabs bris pa 'dis blo dman gzhan la'ang shin tu phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
